assessment: The deadline is computed once, checked using >= before every inbox dequeue, and applies only while session is None; rejected requests do not renew it.

The deterministic regression executes actual serve/reader/contracts/SQLite; only coordinator-local time/os/sys references and emit are replaced, not shared standard modules or asyncio scheduling time.

Assertions distinguish exact-deadline and after-deadline late hello rejection from timely hello and normal repeated-hello INVALID_STATE handling. Real SQLite writer lease is reopened after each serve run.

Parent RSS injection selects the actual target subprocess PID while still alive; only parent sampler lookup is changed, while both child workers execute real candidate source and actual memory guards.

Target durable state must be failed with INTERNAL_ERROR, no result or operation marker; sibling must succeed with exact immutable result page. Extra observer confirms target reaped with -9 and sibling with 0 before pytest process ends.

Windows static compatibility: controlled stdin read never consumes fd123, asyncio clock is untouched, SIGTERM setup remains standard and restores in finally; Darwin-only RSS case is explicitly skipped outside Darwin. No production platform branch or worker cleanup path is changed.
